subject: Starlite AI — hosted API traffic & budget confirmation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@starlite.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Starlite AI — hosted API traffic & budget confirmation

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and the numbers we discussed so we’re all aligned before I model the pricing: 

Key estimates you gave on the call:
- Expected steady-state monthly token consumption: 90M–150M tokens/month (main production workloads).
- Add-on test/ingestion traffic for analytics: ~10M tokens/month (intermittent).
- Expected peak sustained TPS during morning batch and promo spikes: ~160 TPS sustained (5–8 minute windows) with short bursts to ~240 TPS (30–60s).
- Typical request size: 600–1,200 tokens (avg ~800).
- Target economic goal: landed cost roughly $40–$60 per 1M tokens at scale; procurement is aiming for <$50/1M if possible.

Open questions from my side (so I can prepare a formal proposal):
1) Do you have a committed monthly budget range (ARR or monthly) you can share for this initial rollout? You mentioned "mid-five figures/month" on the call — can you confirm a $/month band?
2) How important is guaranteed burst capacity vs. acceptable throttling/backoff? We can propose dedicated burst pools for predictable spikes or a best-effort burst option at lower cost.
3) Who is the procurement contact and what timeline for MSA / PO would you expect?

Next steps I’ll take:
- I’ll draft a two-slab pricing proposal (100M and 200M commit) with unit economics and burst options and share a spreadsheet.
- Run a short lab load test if you can provide an API key/sample payloads (we can mirror your typical 800-token requests).

Attaching: starlite-usage-estimates.csv (your numbers from the call) and our template pricing sheet.

If that summary looks correct, I’ll send the proposal tomorrow morning PST. Thanks — enjoyed the demo.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: starlite-usage-estimates.csv (CSV with estimated daily/hourly TPS columns)
Attachment: 2027-Starlite-Hosted-Pricing-Sheet.xlsx (pricing draft)

From: Emma Chen <emma@starlite.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2027 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Starlite AI — hosted API traffic & budget confirmation

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear recap. That matches our notes. A few clarifications: 

- Monthly budget: looking to commit ~$6,000–$12,000/month initially, with a goal to scale to ~$30k+/mo within 9–12 months if model quality holds. We may be able to stretch on short-term pilots.
- Burst behavior: we’d prefer guaranteed short bursts for the promo windows — those are user-facing and we cannot have visible throttling. If there’s a named burst SLA with an associated price, please include that.
- Procurement: procurement@starlite.ai is the point; timeline likely 4–8 weeks for initial PO and SSO setup, faster if the MSA is standard.

I’ve attached our internal PDF summarizing expected daily traffic patterns (mostly US west). Happy to hop on a 20-minute follow-up if you want to go line-by-line on pricing.

Thanks,
Emma
Head of Product | Starlite AI
emma@starlite.ai

Attachment: starlite-traffic-patterns.pdf (internal traffic heatmap)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Starlite AI — hosted API traffic & budget confirmation

Folks — forwarding Emma’s reply. Key points for the proposal: 
- Anchor commit tier: start with a 100M tokens/month slab at a target $/1M we can justify to hit Starlite’s $6k–12k/mo budget.
- Upside: show 200M slab for scaled economics (they aim to get to $30k+/mo in 9–12 months).
- Burst SLA requested: guaranteed short bursts (up to ~240 TPS) for promo windows — we should include a premium burst add-on or reserved burst pool pricing.
- Timeline: procurement expects 4–8 weeks; security/SSO will be blocking items.

Proposed draft numbers (internal only — we will refine):
- 100M commit: $55/1M tokens (list), propose a discounted effective rate of $42/1M with a 12-month commit + reserved burst add-on.
- 200M commit: $48/1M (list), propose $36/1M effective with extended commit/volume SLA.
- Burst reserved pool: additional flat fee + per-1M overage to keep predictable.

Sean — can you validate the reserved-burst pricing model and whether we can offer a temporary promotional credit for the first month to get them past the PO? Lauren — I’ll draft a one-pager for procurement and send the pricing spreadsheet to Emma today.

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Chen <emma@starlite.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Starlite AI — hosted API pricing proposal (initial draft)

Hi Emma — attaching the initial pricing draft and a short explainer. High level proposal (draft):

Option A — Intro commit (fast ramp)
- Commit: 100M tokens / month
- Effective price: $42 per 1M tokens (after 15% commit discount)
- Included burst: up to 160 TPS sustained; short bursts to 240 TPS covered up to 30 minutes/month.
- Overages: $60 per 1M tokens above committed volume.

Option B — Scale commit
- Commit: 200M tokens / month
- Effective price: $36 per 1M tokens (after 25% commit discount)
- Included burst: up to 200 TPS sustained; short bursts to 300 TPS covered up to 60 minutes/month.
- Overages: $48 per 1M tokens above committed volume.

Other items:
- One-month free trial credit to help with initial testing/load validation.
- Dedicated onboarding session + optional 2-hour architecture review (no charge for first session).
- Security & compliance: we can provide SOC2 Type II report and an audit package on request; please share the security contact.
- Procurement items: we can accept a PO and standard MSA; I’ve attached a procurement checklist for your legal team.

Attachments: 2027-Starlite-Hosted-Pricing-Sheet.xlsx (detailed line items)
Link: https://redwood.app/deals/STL-2027-0923 (deal workspace)

Next steps:
- Can you confirm which option looks closest to your expectations and share procurement contact & preferred timeline?
- If yes, we’ll schedule a short technical ramp call and spin up a limited reserved burst pool for validation.

If helpful, I’m free for a quick call tomorrow PST to finalize the slab.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0142

Attachment: 2027-Starlite-Hosted-Pricing-Sheet.xlsx
